about_the_game: In The Creator Demo, you become a master designer and can try out all key game mechanics by creating stylish and cozy spaces in the world's most beautiful corners. No limitations, no stress—just pure creativity and inspiration!
detailed_description: In The Creator Demo, you become a master designer and can try out all key game mechanics by creating stylish and cozy spaces in the world's most beautiful corners. No limitations, no stress—just pure creativity and inspiration!
name: The Creator Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 970 GTX or AMD Radeon 570 HD series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD

short_description: The Creator Demo is a limited edition where you design unique spaces and territories. Enjoy the creative journey with no need to search for resources or worry about errors, crafting breathtaking interiors and exteriors in scenic corners around the globe.
